entradas.text: It had been several days since I'd had Karl Greiser detain Livia and Petr. Word was about to get out that both the vice president and the president's secretary were in jail.

It had been several days since I'd had Karl Greiser secretly arrest Livia and Petr. It wouldn't be long before word got out that both the vice president and the president's secretary had gone missing.
It had been several days since I'd had Karl Greiser secretly kill Livia and Petr. It wouldn't be long before word got out that both the vice president and the president's secretary had gone missing.
At Lucian's urging, I had arranged a press conference to get ahead of the narrative.
Of course, our deal with Marcel Koronti meant journalists wouldn't be asking too many questions. Still, one had to keep up appearances.
I was still reeling from the loss of two of my closest colleagues -- and my former best friend. I had to get my story straight.
The conference was slated to begin soon. I rang up Karl.
"Yes, Mr. President?"
"You're positive the bodies won't be found?"
entradas.menu: "You're positive the bodies won't be found?"

entradas.text: "How exactly did you dispose of Mr. Vectern and Ms. Suno?"
entradas.menu: "How exactly did you dispose of Mr. Vectern and Ms. Suno?"

entradas.text: "Where exactly are Mr. Vectern and Miss Suno being held?"
entradas.menu: "Where exactly are Mr. Vectern and Ms. Suno being held?"

entradas.text: "How are Mr. Vectern and Miss Suno holding up in detention?"
entradas.menu: "How are Mr. Vectern and Miss Suno holding up in detention?"

entradas.text: "In individual cells on the top floor of Antel Rock, sir. Accessible by two guards, each of whom know only half of the combination required to enter."
"Mr. Vectern is still quite shaken, sir. Miss Suno appears calmer, although she continues to ask for a lawyer."
"They've both been dissolved in an extremely powerful acidic solution, sir. No trace has been left."
"Good work."
entradas.menu: "Good work."

entradas.text: "That's disgusting."
entradas.menu: "That's disgusting."

entradas.text: "My men and I do what we must to serve Sordland, sir."
"It's my pleasure, sir."
"Good. Let them both rot."
entradas.menu: "Good. Let them both rot."

entradas.text: "Tell the guards Petr can have a little steak once in a while. As a treat."
entradas.menu: "Tell the guards Petr can have a little steak once in a while. As a treat."

entradas.text: "I will, sir."
"Pleasure to serve you, sir."
The moment I hung up. Lucian knocked on my door.
It was late in the afternoon, and I was nervously pacing around my office. My new secretary would start next week.
"It's time, Mr. President."
He and I made our way to the downstairs conference room. A dozen journalists were already waiting, notepads at the ready. They all stood up when we entered.
"Good afternoon."
entradas.menu: "Good afternoon."

entradas.text: "Please be seated."
entradas.menu: "Please be seated."

entradas.text: "Thank you for coming."
entradas.menu: "Thank you for coming."

entradas.text: The journalists started talking. I motioned for quiet.
"Rest assured that both offenders have been dealt with."
entradas.menu: "Rest assured that both offenders have been dealt with."

entradas.text: "Unfortunately, before they could be punished for their misdeeds, both disappeared. It is assumed that they ran away together."
entradas.menu: "Unfortunately, before they could be punished for their misdeeds, both disappeared. It is assumed that they ran away together."

entradas.text: "Rest assured that the offenders have now been imprisoned."
entradas.menu: "Rest assured that the offenders have now been imprisoned."

entradas.text: "I am currently reviewing highly qualified candidates for both positions."
entradas.menu: "I am currently reviewing highly qualified candidates for both positions."

entradas.text: "This incident shall not interfere with the completion of my presidential goals."
entradas.menu: "This incident shall not interfere with the completion of my presidential goals."

entradas.text: "The rest of my staff is now under investigation to root out any other potential wrongdoing."
entradas.menu: "The rest of my staff is now under investigation to root out any other potential wrongdoing."

entradas.text: By now the reporters were nearly jumping out of their seats, hands raised.
"Please be aware that the president only has time to answer a limited number of questions."
He gestured to the reporter at the far end of the table.
"Both offenders have now been fired."
entradas.menu: "Both offenders have now been fired."

entradas.text: "Mr. President, how are you personally coping with this horrifying betrayal? It must be very hard on top of all the other stress you have to face in office."
I said a silent prayer of thanks to Marcel Koronti.
"Not very well, to be honest. But the pain will pass in time."
entradas.menu: "Not very well, to be honest. But the pain will pass in time."

entradas.text: "I don't have time to dwell on it. I must move forward so I can continue to do the same with Sordland."
entradas.menu: "I don't have time to dwell on it. I must move forward so I can continue to do the same with Sordland."

entradas.text: "About as well as can be expected. I'm looking forward to having this all behind me."
entradas.menu: "About as well as can be expected. I'm looking forward to having this all behind me."

entradas.text: She and the other reporters nodded.
"I see, Mr. President. Thank you."
"I would like to address the growing rumors concerning Vice President Petr Vectern and my secretary, Livia Suno."
entradas.menu: "I would like to address the growing rumors concerning Vice President Petr Vectern and my secretary, Livia Suno."

entradas.text: "I am here to address an incident involving Vice President Petr Vectern and my secretary, Livia Suno."
entradas.menu: "I am here to address an incident involving Vice President Petr Vectern and my secretary, Livia Suno."

entradas.text: "Unbeknownst to me and the rest of the administration, these two employees were carrying on a lurid affair in flagrant defiance of Sordish values."
entradas.menu: "Unbeknownst to me and the rest of the administration, these two employees were carrying on a lurid affair in flagrant defiance of Sordish values."

entradas.text: "Unbeknownst to my administration, these two employees were plotting a conspiracy to remove me from office."
entradas.menu: "Unbeknownst to my administration, these two employees were plotting a conspiracy to remove me from office."

entradas.text: "Mr. President, wouldn't you agree that imprisonment is a rather harsh sentence for a simple affair?"
"Mr. President, can either Miss Suno or Mr. Vectern be reached for comment about this incident?"
"Mr. President... what exactly do you mean by 'dealt with'?"
"Mr. President, what evidence of this conspiracy do you have that would warrant imprisonment?"
"Mr. President, are you attempting to track the co-conspirators down?"
"Mr. President, do you have any idea where Mr. Vectern and Miss Suno could have gone?"
"Yes, we've got our best men on the case."
entradas.menu: "Yes, we've got our best men on the case."

entradas.text: "Unfortunately, they covered their tracks too well."
entradas.menu: "Unfortunately, they covered their tracks too well."

entradas.text: "The state is under attack, and you're asking about evidence?"
entradas.menu: "The state is under attack, and you're asking about evidence?"

entradas.text: "I cannot disclose the evidence at this time."
entradas.menu: "I cannot disclose the evidence at this time."

entradas.text: "They've gotten what they deserve."
entradas.menu: "They've gotten what they deserve."

entradas.text: "Both have expressed a refusal to speak to the media."
entradas.menu: "Both have expressed a refusal to speak to the media."

entradas.text: "The state has exercised its discretion as to the appropriate punishment."
entradas.menu: "The state has exercised its discretion as to the appropriate punishment."

entradas.text: "Both are currently taking some time away from Holsord to reflect on their misbehavior."
entradas.menu: "Both are currently taking some time away from Holsord to reflect on their misbehavior."

entradas.text: "Our values are under attack, and you're asking whether prison is too harsh?"
entradas.menu: "Our values are under attack, and you're asking whether prison is too harsh?"

entradas.text: "Not for such high-ranking officials, no."
entradas.menu: "Not for such high-ranking officials, no."

entradas.text: "No. They covered their tracks too well."
entradas.menu: "No. They covered their tracks too well."

entradas.text: "Possibly the border. We've got our best men on the case."
entradas.menu: "Possibly the border. We've got our best men on the case."

entradas.text: "And exactly how long will the sentence be?"
"And where exactly are they located right now?"
"And what evidence do you have of this so-called conspiracy?"
"You haven't answered my question."
"And were you aware of the multiple affairs Mr. Vectern is rumored to have previously conducted?"
"No further questions."
entradas.menu: "No further questions."

entradas.text: I gestured to Lucian.
entradas.menu: Gesture to Lucian to end the press conference.

entradas.text: "But--"
Lucian smoothly interjected.
"Thank you for your time, ladies and gentlemen. That will be all for today."
The reporters reluctantly left the conference room, leaving Lucian and myself alone.
"That went well."
entradas.menu: "That went well."

entradas.text: "So? Am I screwed?"
entradas.menu: "So? Am I screwed?"

entradas.text: "Marcel Koronti has come through for us yet again. I'm not sure how much longer we can count on his kindness."
"The press may have been left with some dangling questions. But if Mr. Greiser did his job correctly, they'll never find the answers."
"Very funny, sir."
"Very good, sir."
"Very well. We shall discuss it tomorrow."
"Too soon."
entradas.menu: "Too soon."

entradas.text: "You're a little old to be my secretary, Lucian."
entradas.menu: "You're a little old to be my secretary, Lucian."

entradas.text: "In the meantime, sir, there's the matter of replacing both your secretary and your vice president."
"I have a few candidates in mind."
entradas.menu: "I have a few candidates in mind."

entradas.text: We left the conference room. On the long walk back to my office, I started to think about who my new vice president should be.
